# CNN International Edition

> > Global news network delivering breaking news, world events, political analysis, and business coverage with emphasis on U.S. politics, international affairs, and economic trends.

CNN International Edition provides comprehensive news coverage spanning global regions, political developments including Trump administration updates and polling data, economic analysis, and curated video content. The platform aggregates news from major world regions including the Americas, China, Middle East, and features specialized sections for political polling and presidential approval ratings.

## Key Topics

- Breaking news coverage
- Trump administration and approval ratings
- Political polling and poll aggregation
- Iran conflict and Middle East tensions
- Strait of Hormuz developments
- U.S.-China relations and Taiwan
- Economic markets and forecasts
- World news and international affairs
- Presidential politics
- Public opinion analysis
- Video news content
- Americas regional coverage
- Israel-Middle East relations

## Breaking News & Headlines

- [Breaking News, Latest News and Videos | CNN](https://edition.cnn.com/): CNN homepage with breaking U.S., world, politics & entertainment news
- [CNN Headlines | CNN](https://edition.cnn.com/videos/fast/cnn-headlines): Curated video channel featuring major news across politics & entertainment

## World News Coverage

- [World news - breaking news, video, headlines and opinion | CNN](https://edition.cnn.com/world.html): International news from Europe, Asia, Africa, Middle East & Americas
- [Americas news - breaking news, video, headlines and opinion | CNN](https://edition.cnn.com/world/americas/index.html): Americas coverage: South America, Canada, Mexico news & breaking stories
- [China news - breaking news, video, headlines and opinion | CNN](https://edition.cnn.com/world/china): China coverage: US relations, Taiwan tensions & economy news

## U.S. Politics & Government

- [US | CNN](https://edition.cnn.com/us): US domestic news covering federal agencies, law enforcement & policy
- [Donald J. Trump news | CNN Politics](https://edition.cnn.com/politics/president-donald-trump-47): Trump administration coverage with approval ratings & executive actions
- [CNN Polls | CNN Politics](https://edition.cnn.com/polling): Political polling data on Trump, Congress & economy with aggregation

## Business & Economy

- [Economy | CNN Business](https://edition.cnn.com/business/economy): Economic news, markets data, mortgage rates & financial forecasts
